summary: Minerva Neurosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $75 million of common stock through Leerink Partners. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. The agent receives 3% compensation, with no escrow or trust arrangement. Shares trade on Nasdaq under NERV; last price $5.22. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural special-situation mechanics are present. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction with no triggering event or unusual terms, thus no risk-arb angle.
